entry.author: West Coast Regional Council
entry.summary:
What would happen to your business if disaster struck tomorrow? 
Hear from Homebuilders West Coast Trust about their firsthand experience of past disruptions, including what got them through, what they’d do differently, and how they’re preparing for whatever comes next. 
Whether you’re just starting to think about business continuity, or looking to strengthen your existing plans, there’s plenty to learn from one another. The simple steps you take today could make all the difference tomorrow. 
Westport Business Recovery Stories are part of the Westport Business Resilience & Continuity Campaign by Resilient Westport. For more, see http://resilientwestport.co.nz/
@westcoastregionalcouncil5171
